race.comment: FACE THE WILD (9) was kept very safe in betting first up in a stronger race at Caulfield, fading to finish 10th but not beaten far by a smart 2yo. She's been given time since then and comes a fair way back in grade now on her home deck, expect she goes close. ISLE OF MONA (10) resumes having been pitched up in a couple of good races last time in. The fourth to Big Sky on debut is strong form before finishing out the back behind subsequent G1 winner Streisand. Should be ready to go. WHAT ONCE WAS (12) ran a good race on debut at Swan Hill when in the market and will be better for it. She'll be up on speed and hard to run down. PRAGMATIC LADY (11) is a filly by Prague on debut who can run well off a decent jumpout while NAUGHTY JAMIE (5) wasn't beaten far on debut and is in the mix.
